name: Fire Tar
summary: Across the eastern Barrens, Razormane spellcasters carry Fire Tar. Horde shamans bring it to Telf Joolam, who brews it into a Fire Sapta that lets them commune with fire spirits.

sections.title: A Concoction of the Razormane
sections.body: Razormane geomancers, mystics, and thornweavers carry Fire Tar. The quilboar use it in their harsh magic and rituals, where its power is tuned to flame. Shamanic instructors prize the substance as a worldly reagent. It helps mortal senses reach the raw fury of the elements.

sections.title: The Path to the Fire Totem
sections.body: Young orc and troll shamans travel high among Durotar's crags to Telf Joolam, where they forge their fire totems. Telf asks them to bring a reagent pouch taken from Burning Blade cultists and Fire Tar gathered from the Razormane. He brews the two ingredients into a fire sapta. A shaman who drinks it can perceive the fire spirits waiting atop the nearby peaks.

faq.q: What is Fire Tar used for?
aliases: why do i need fire tar
faq.answer: Shamans bring Fire Tar to Telf Joolam in Durotar. He brews it with reagents from the Burning Blade into a Fire Sapta. The brew lets a shaman see and commune with fire spirits to earn a fire totem.
Spellcasting Razormane quilboar carry Fire Tar in the eastern Barrens. They include Razormane Geomancers, Mystics, Thornweavers, and Water Seekers.

faq.q: Why do shamans need ingredients tied to hostile spellcasters?
faq.answer: Saptas need physical components saturated with the matching element. Razormane casters and Burning Blade warlocks channel heat and destructive flame. Their everyday materials carry the fiery essence needed to awaken a shaman's elemental sight.

faq.q: Where does Telf Joolam brew the Fire Sapta?
faq.answer: Telf Joolam brews the Fire Sapta on a high cliff overlooking Durotar's crags. The cliff lies near the path between Razor Hill and the Barrens. He teaches initiates to balance flame's destructive and creative nature.

angles.text: As a shaman, gathering Fire Tar is an essential rite of passage. You seek elemental resonance in the wider world, then use it to brew the Fire Sapta and earn your Fire Totem.
As a member of the Horde, you cross the Southfury River from Durotar into the Barrens to gather Fire Tar. There you face the aggressive Razormane tribes.
